name: npm-release-0110
title: Run scripts/release-npm.sh for 0.11.0 and verify the published package
description: After the upstream sync is merged: freeze the release commit, stop the 8505 dev server, run scripts/release-npm.sh 0.11.0 (bump -> next build --webpack -> dry-run -> user-2FA publish -> registry verification -> bump commit), add the package audit (version/file list/forbidden patterns/font licenses), archive the tgz, smoke-test the installed package, then push and restore the dev server. Note: npm currently returns E401, the user must npm login first.
creator: xupeng
